name: pkg-mismatch
about: A package of another build beside the current ones: gamelab-stampfake carries a package check module exactly as tools/build.py generates it, made with a library stamp no build has. The check logs the mismatch, calls HWP::Packages::Mismatch, and the player gets the chat line in town; the real packages still pass their own checks.

steps.pattern: \[HWP:core\] package HWP-stampfake was built with library 000000000000 but library [0-9a-f]{12} loaded
steps.name: the other build is logged

steps.pattern: \[HWP\] HammerwatchPlus packages from different updates are enabled together \(HWP-stampfake differ from the rest\)
steps.name: the player is told
